purpose: The fitting pool for the per-type temperature (roadmap item 1.1b): 500 items of every question type, drawn from the jev-bench VALIDATION split, with the per-config counts and the seed fixed here so the run is reproducible. The data itself stays outside the repository.
notes: The pool keeps only licences that oblige nothing beyond attribution: every config named here is Apache-2.0, MIT, CC0, CC BY, or free-for-any-purpose. The share-alike configs (boolq, arc_challenge) and the non-commercial ones (chaosnli) and the research-use ones (mnli, yelp5) and the undeclared ones (sst5, stsb, sms_spam, fever_evidence) are out, with the reason in the excluded block.

boolq was in the first version of this plan (80 noul items) and was swapped out for 80 more paws items. The swap was made before any compute: no run, no fit and no measurement used the boolq items, so nothing is contaminated by it.

The swap changed the noul's per-config counts (paws 90 -> 170, boolq 80 -> 0) and no other count: the type mix is still 500 choice, 500 noul, 500 score, the total is still 1500, and the human distribution is still on 250 items of every type. WHICH ITEMS those are is a different question - see the next note.

ONE GENERATOR FOR THE WHOLE PLAN, so changing a count moves the items drawn after it: the choice type is drawn first and its 500 items are untouched, the noul draws shift (boolq's 80 go out, 120 different noul items come in), and the score draws shift with them (68 of the 500 score items are different). Measured: 1232 of the 1500 ids are the same as in the first version of the plan, 268 are different. The pool is reproducible for a GIVEN plan; it is not a superset of an earlier one.

civil_comments.note: PROVENANCE: the rows jev-bench ships as civil_comments train and validation are the upstream VALIDATION split, not the upstream train split (measured: all 8,492 distinct comment texts are in the upstream validation parquet, and none of the ids index the same comment there). The licence verdict is unchanged - validation is trainable under the record's rule and the licence is CC0 either way. CAVEAT: 71 of those 8,492 distinct comments are also in the upstream test split, the yardstick; measured on this pool: all 250 civil_comments items are in the upstream validation split, exactly 1 of them is among the 71, and the pool shares 0 texts with the jev-bench test sample (whose 100 civil_comments items are all from the upstream test split). The noul's target is the `toxicity` field, which is MEASURED to be the annotator share (every one of the 2,913 distinct values over the upstream train split is exactly k/n, 0 failures), not a continuous score.
